data.title: Singapore Institute of Advanced Medicine Ends Proposed Loan Conversion
data.description:
Singapore Institute of Advanced Medicine Holdings Ltd. ( (SG:9G2) ) has issued an update.

Singapore Institute of Advanced Medicine Holdings Ltd. announced that it and Espeetex Sdn. Bhd. will not proceed with the proposed conversion of S$22.0 million in shareholder loans into new shares, after conditions precedent could not be fulfilled by the 13 November 2026 long-stop date.

On 7 November, the parties terminated the conversion deed while separately extending the loans’ maturity to 31 December 2027. The company will withdraw its application for a Whitewash Waiver; the extension is an interested person transaction below the applicable 3% threshold.

data.title: Banca Sistema Completes Banca CF+ Merger and Capital Increase
data.description:
An announcement from Banca Sistema S.p.A. ( (IT:BST) ) is now available.

The incorporation of Banca CF+ into Banca Sistema was registered on November 7, 2026, making the merger legally effective immediately, with accounting and tax effects from November 1, 2026. To execute the exchange ratio, Banca Sistema increased share capital by €6.03 million through 50,246,553 ordinary shares, which are currently unlisted on Euronext Milan, bringing total capital to €15.68 million.
